value.rationale: Gałecka identifies classification of nearly free conic-line weak combinatorics as a motivated problem and leaves degree nine unresolved. The result excludes a concrete, inequality-compatible basket for a natural three-conic/three-line component type, reducing the surviving near-free possibilities to one. The obstruction is geometric (concurrency/triangle versus shared tangencies) and not a routine rearrangement of the earlier numerical inequalities. No existence or full-degree classification is claimed.
